summary: Iteration 21 — Historical weekly analytics rollup. 7/7 backend pytest passed (test_iteration21_weekly_analytics.py). Verified: GET /api/leagues/{lid}/weekly-analytics returns the documented shape with team_id and league-wide modes, including season_summary and year_over_year arrays. Verified backfill endpoint is idempotent (rows_written stable across 2 calls) and 404s on unknown league. Verified simulate_week now upserts 2 week_summaries rows per matchup (manual end-to-end: simulated week 999 in Ice Kings → 2 rows written, then cleaned up). Verified seed integrity via DB count: 9,808 week_summaries (>=9000). chriszarek has 10 W1-W10 rows in season=2025-26 across all 5 seed leagues + 26-row historical seasons 2021-22..2023-24. Non-regression: test_crown_flow.py + test_trade_flow.py both passed (with the documented timestamps-cleanup between them). Frontend: LIVE badge correctly renders for chriszarek on Analytics page in Ice Kings — BUT the weekly chart shows ONLY W99 at ~4,648 pts (a leftover row from test_crown_flow.py auto-simulating final matchups under season=2026-27), NOT the W1..W10 200-320 range from seed_analytics.py. Root cause: _current_season() returns '2026-27' for Jan 2026 (calendar year + 1), but seed_analytics.py wrote 2025-26. The FE hook does not pass `season=`, so the endpoint defaults to current-calendar-year and finds only the small auto-crown rows.

minor.issue: Default season='2026-27' (Jan 2026 calendar year + 1) does not align with NHL season convention nor the seed_analytics.py CURRENT_SEASON='2025-26'. Hockey/fantasy seasons start in October, so before Oct of any calendar year `y`, the season should still be `(y-1)-${y%100 padded}` (e.g. Jan 2026 → '2025-26'). Caused the FE to show only the 1 auto-crown row at W99 instead of the rich W1..W10 seed.

Returns rows_written counted as raw upsert calls (incl. updates), not as net inserts. Idempotency test still passes because both runs return the same number, but the field name implies first-run-only writes. Consider renaming to rows_upserted or returning {inserted, updated} split.

action_items: [HIGH] Align season default: change `_current_season()` in /app/backend/routes/analytics.py (and the inline duplicate in /app/backend/routes/matchups.py L207) to NHL season convention — month<10 → '${y-1}-${str(y)[-2:]}' else '${y}-${str(y+1)[-2:]}'. This makes Jan 2026 → '2025-26' and the FE chart will pick up the seeded 10 weeks automatically. Alternative: re-run `python /app/backend/seed_analytics.py` after changing CURRENT_SEASON to match _current_season(), but then the AC says season=2025-26 must work — so the helper fix is preferred.
[MED] Fix '+-18' concat in Analytics.tsx vs-league-avg card: replace `+{avgPointsFor - avgLeague}` with `{delta>=0?'+':''}{delta}`.
[LOW] Have routes/matchups.py reuse routes/analytics._current_season() instead of inlining the same formula — single source of truth.
[LOW] Consider renaming backfill response field `rows_written` → `rows_upserted` to reflect that it counts both inserts and updates (idempotency works, but name is misleading).
critical_code_review_comments: _current_season() is implemented identically in routes/analytics.py and inlined in routes/matchups.py simulate_week (L207). DRY violation + risk of divergence — extract to a shared helper module.

routes/analytics.py L97 `league_avg_total = sum(league_avg_by_week.values())` then rounds — this is a SUM of per-week averages, not a true season-long league average. Should be `mean(values)` not sum. Currently season_summary.leagueAvg returns a number ~10× larger than expected.

routes/analytics.py L86 league-wide branch sets `pointsAgainst = total_pf` (mirrors itself) — semantically wrong but no FE consumer relies on it yet. Either remove the field or compute against the next-week opposing teams.

routes/analytics.py L151 leagueAvg per season uses `sa['league_total'] / len(sa['team_count'])` — that's points-per-team-per-season, not points-per-week. Should divide by (team_count * weeks) for a comparable league-avg figure.

seed_analytics.py uses `hash(str(t['_id']))` for team strength — Python hash randomization means the synthetic YoY differs across runs (mitigated only because the upsert key is league+season+week+team). Consider hashlib.md5 for deterministic strengths.

Analytics.tsx fallback YoY hardcodes a 2025-26 row that conflicts with live data (line 61). When live data is partial it still gets replaced by full STATIC_YOY in else-branch — currently fine but brittle.

rca of the issue:
The acceptance criteria 'chart shows W1..W10 in 200-320 range' fails because of a season-naming mismatch:
  - seed_analytics.py writes CURRENT_SEASON='2025-26'
  - routes/analytics._current_season() and the inlined version in routes/matchups.py compute `f'{y}-{str(y+1)[-2:]}'` where y = current calendar year (2026 in Jan 2026) → 'season=2026-27'
  - Analytics.tsx calls the endpoint without `season=`, so backend defaults to '2026-27' which has only 1 row (W99 from test_crown_flow.py auto-simulation)
Fix priority: change _current_season() to NHL season convention — month<10 returns previous-year-pair. Reproduction: GET /api/leagues/69e46af167999bfb85c39628/weekly-analytics?team_id=69e59b30cbd3fea02a914c61 returns 1 week. Same call with `&season=2025-26` returns 10 weeks at 200-320 pts.
